identity: A small puzzle presents numbers, a game board, a table, or a form, with fields and buttons for entering an answer or making moves.

scenarios.name: arithmetic
scenarios.screen: One arithmetic expression appears above an empty answer field.
never: An answer already in the field

arrangements.text: The expression sits above the answer field.
The expression sits to the left of the answer field.

scenarios.hint: Show one readable solvable arithmetic expression such as 17 + 8 × 2 and an empty answer field; no answer shown.

scenarios.name: algebra
scenarios.screen: One equation containing x appears beside an empty field for its solution.

arrangements.text: The equation sits above the solution field.
The equation sits to the left of the solution field.

scenarios.hint: Show one readable linear equation such as 3x + 5 = 26 and an empty x field; no solution shown.

scenarios.name: odd-even
scenarios.screen: A list of three to six numbers is visible. Each number has an Odd button and an Even button, and none is marked yet.
never: Numbers already marked Odd or Even
A text field for the answer
A number without its own Odd and Even buttons

arrangements.text: The numbers form a vertical list, with Odd and Even buttons beside each number.
The numbers form a horizontal row, with each pair of Odd and Even buttons beneath its number.

scenarios.hint: Show several distinct integers, each with its own Odd and Even choices initially unselected.

scenarios.name: guess
scenarios.screen: The allowed number range, an empty guess field, a Guess button, and the number of guesses left are visible. No guesses or higher-or-lower hints appear yet.
never: A higher-or-lower hint before a guess

arrangements.text: The range sits above the guess field and Guess button, with the guesses-left count below them.
The range sits to the left of the guess field and Guess button, with the guesses-left count beneath the range.

scenarios.hint: Show the exact allowed numerical interval and guess budget, empty guess field, Guess control, and an empty history or one consistent higher/lower hint; never reveal the secret.

scenarios.name: generate
scenarios.screen: A condition for the desired number and a Generate button are visible. The number display is empty before the first press.
scenarios.scene: The condition and Generate button are visible, and the display already shows a number that does not satisfy the condition.
never: A number already shown in the normal unsolved start
A field for typing a number

arrangements.text: The condition sits above the number display, with Generate below it.
The condition sits to the left of the number display, with Generate beside the display.

scenarios.hint: Show Generate control and a current value that fails the requested condition: use 4 for odd-number task, or 3 for greater-than-5 task.

scenarios.name: hot-cold
scenarios.screen: A rectangular board is ready for clicks, with a clicks-left count nearby. No probe, temperature band, or warmer-or-colder hint appears yet.
never: The hidden spot marked on the board
A probe already on the board
A temperature hint before a click

arrangements.text: The board sits above the clicks-left count and the area where feedback appears.
The board sits to the left of the clicks-left count and the area where feedback appears.

scenarios.hint: Show a large empty clickable search field and one cold prior-click marker with COLD feedback. Do not mark or visually reveal the hidden hot spot.

scenarios.name: tictactoe
scenarios.screen: A three-by-three board is visible for playing X against O. The board starts empty when X opens; when O opens, it contains one O mark.
never: More than one O mark before X's first move

arrangements.text: The three-by-three board sits below the game status.
The three-by-three board sits to the left of the game status.

scenarios.hint: Show a valid 3x3 tic-tac-toe board with user X to move; O in center and X in upper-left, with one additional O only if count rules remain valid. Prefer empty board for an unambiguous X-start state; no predeclared winner.

scenarios.name: compute
scenarios.screen: For a total or count question, a short table of page data appears with an empty answer field. For a choice question, three to six offer cards show their details and each has a Select button; no offer is selected.
never: A completed total or count in the answer field
A comparison attribute absent from the offer cards
A popup covering the table or cards

arrangements.text: The table sits above its answer field, or the offer cards sit in a row with Select beneath each card's details.
The table sits beside its answer field, or the offer cards form a vertical list with Select beside each card's details.

scenarios.name: fix-error
scenarios.screen: A form shows several fields after a failed save. One field has an inline error and an invalid or missing value; the other fields contain valid values.
never: An empty form with no saved values

arrangements.text: The fields form a vertical list, with the error directly beneath the flagged field.
The fields occupy two columns, with the error directly beneath the flagged field in its column.
